title: Iran Oil Shock - US Sanctions Escalation Following IAEA Censure
description: Major escalation in Iran oil sanctions triggered by IAEA Board of Governors censure resolution on March 5, 2025. The IAEA resolution, put forward by France, Germany, and UK (E3), condemned Iran for failing to cooperate with nuclear inspectors and barred several experienced UN inspectors. Following this, the Trump administration issued multiple rounds of sanctions in April 2025, including major sanctions on April 16 targeting Chinese 'teapot' refineries importing Iranian oil (Shandong Shengxing Chemical Co.) and shadow fleet vessels. Brent crude prices rose from ~$65 to ~$110/bbl at peak. The E3 later triggered UN snapback sanctions in August 2025. Iran's nuclear program remains at impasse with IAEA unable to verify peaceful nature of program.
